extracted.intended_audience: Researchers (especially UK-based) and research organisations seeking AHRC / UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Information and application requirements for AHRC / UKRI funding opportunities, including eligibility, funding levels, deadlines, and participating funders. Useful for preparing applications or checking whether an organisation/PI can apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This opportunity is invite-only; unsolicited applications will not be accepted. Confirm invitation status before preparing an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional eligibility (UK research organisation)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only applicants whose employing/legal host organisation is recognised as eligible by UKRI may apply. Check institutional eligibility with UKRI guidance or your research office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award is provided as a grant (not a contract, fellowship, or prize); budgeting and allowable costs should follow grant conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fund / fund size
rubrics_metrics.description: Total fund: £3,000,000 (for the metascience scientometrics opportunity); Total fund: £5,000,000 (for Video games and gambling-related harms opportunity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the overall budget available across awards for the opportunity; does not guarantee award amounts to individual projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximum award (per project)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual projects cannot request more than the stated maximum award for that opportunity; check the specific opportunity page for any additional limits or rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of full economic cost (FEC) funded
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should cost their proposals on a full economic cost basis but be aware that UKRI intends to fund up to the stated percentage (here 80%); applicants/host organisations are expected to identify arrangements to cover the unfunded portion if required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication, opening and closing dates (deadlines and status)
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication date: 28 April 2026; Opening date: 28 April 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date: 2 June 2026 4:00pm UK time (example). Opportunity status: Open.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted within the stated opening and closing windows and by the precise times given (UK time). Check the opportunity status (open, closed, invite-only) before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of funders and co-funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Funders: UK Research and Innovation, Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC), Natural Environment Research Council (NERC), Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC), Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC), Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC), Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC), Medical Research Council (MRC). Co-funders: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The named funders/co-funders indicate which councils are contributing and may influence eligibility, scope, interdisciplinary expectations, reporting requirements, or assessment panels. Review opportunity documentation for funder-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / topic focus of the opportunity
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to develop, validate, and critique novel scientometric indicators for use in research assessment and in metascience research (metascience scientometrics opportunity); Apply for funding to improve understanding of the relationship between gambling and video games and produce insights to inform policy and regulation, support interventions, and promote safe and responsible video games (video games and gambling-related harms opportunity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should clearly align with the stated aims and scope; relevance to the described topic is a core selection consideration. Check the full opportunity text for detailed scope, expected outputs, and eligible activities.
